name: needs-morale-visual
description: Visual check of morale effects from need gauges: after 200+ ticks without rest, morale should decrease as gauges drain below thresholds; needs command and scores output verify need penalty calculation and well-rested bonus when all gauges above 80

expect.note: well-rested bonus: at 100 ticks all gauges are still above 80, morale rises to 100 and wellBeing jumps toward its cap — confirms the file's own claimed bonus, not just the eventual penalty

steps.description: Resolved through the event dialog's own buttons. Decides whether an event is pending from authoritative game state, not from whether the modal has rendered -- a DOM-only probe silently missed events on a no-GPU runner where a frame costs ~6s, leaving them pending so later ticks halted and the run diverged while still passing command mode.

expect.note: gauges have now drained below thresholds — morale and wellBeing both fall from their tick-100 peak, confirming the penalty side of the file's claim
